name: @stewardmd/capacitor-spotify-remote
description: Spotify App Remote (SPTAppRemote) bridge for the PrepNucleus music player. iOS: controls the Spotify app on the same device directly (connect/play/pause/next/previous/seek/shuffle/repeat, player-state events, wake via authorizeAndPlayURI). Android: stub that resolves {available:false} for every call so the Web API path is kept. Exposed to JS as Capacitor.Plugins.SpotifyRemote.
author: StewardMD
